# `make_interval`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Make interval from years, months, weeks, days, hours, mins and secs.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
make_interval([years[, months[, weeks[, days[, hours[, mins[, secs]]]]]]])
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `datetime_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | - |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- make_interval, example 1
> SELECT make_interval(100, 11, 1, 1, 12, 30, 01.001001);
100 years 11 months 8 days 12 hours 30 minutes 1.001001 seconds
```

```sql
-- make_interval, example 2
> SELECT make_interval(100, null, 3);
NULL
```

```sql
-- make_interval, example 3
> SELECT make_interval(0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 100.000001);
1 months 1 days 1 minutes 40.000001 seconds
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
